# opnsense_nginx_resolver (Resource)

nginx DNS resolvers (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Other ▸ Resolver**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (Set of String) Enter a list of IP addresses and ports (optional). Uses port 53 if omitted. Like "8.8.8.8, [2001:4860:4860::8888], 8.8.8.8:5353".
- `description` (String) Brief description for reference.

### Optional

- `ipv4_off` (Boolean) Do not request IPv4 addresses. Defaults to `false`.
- `ipv6_off` (Boolean) Do not request IPv6 addresses. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeout` (Number) Resolver time out in seconds. NGINX default (if empty) is 30 seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `valid` (Number) Override response TTL in seconds. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx DNS resolver.
